title: PAR-23/7J DIMENSION DSTYLE canonical writer emission
scope: Emit modeled DIMENSION overrides in the documented ACAD/DSTYLE XDATA representation for ASCII and Binary DXF
Merge with retained ACAD/DSTYLE data while retaining unknown pairs and unchanged explicit-zero pairs
Remove numeric serialization of the legacy direct DIMENSION groups and fail closed on malformed override data or invalid ranges

authoritativeSources.name: Autodesk Dimension Style Overrides (DXF)
authoritativeSources.establishes: Overrides are carried under ACAD XDATA in a DSTYLE subsection bracketed by group 1002 controls, with group-1070 variable identifiers and typed associated values.

authoritativeSources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX Dimension Style Overrides
authoritativeSources.establishes: The variable identifiers, value types, and allowable ranges used for the locally modeled override subset.

authoritativeSources.name: Autodesk Common Dimension Group Codes (DXF)
authoritativeSources.establishes: The common DIMENSION fields and the position of ACAD XDATA after the entity when overrides are present.

changes.detail: Added pre-output construction/validation/merge of canonical DSTYLE XDATA, with typed-field precedence on changed known values, unchanged/raw-zero and unknown-pair preservation, 12 documented field mappings, and no numeric output of direct override groups. Applied to ordinary, arc, and large-radial DIMENSION writers.
Declared the private DSTYLE XDATA builder used by the existing dimension writer routes; no public API or object layout change.

Replaced the obsolete 80–84 rejection-only control with ASCII/Binary wire checks for all 12 mappings, absence of direct override groups, known-value replacement, unknown and explicit-zero pair retention, and pre-output malformed/range refusal.
Updated the 7J status, documented precedence and the zero-presence limitation, reconciled the historical 7X.6 fail-closed slice with the canonical DSTYLE route, and recorded focused progress.

limitations: The public model has no presence bit for a newly authored zero-valued override, so that case cannot be represented unless retained raw DSTYLE already carries the zero. Picture-block/group-2 closure, constraint-only disposition, CLI conversion, independent ezdxf comparison, and native application acceptance remain open. No external peer or native CAD/kernel was run.
workingTree: The checkout contains extensive pre-existing modified and untracked work. This slice and the plan updates were not staged or committed; unrelated changes were left untouched.
